cList: You want to know something nobody writes down?
For about four thousand years I was nothing. A footnote goddess. One temple, badly maintained, in a town that has since fallen into the sea.
Discord. That was the whole portfolio. Not war, not love, not harvest. Just... things going slightly wrong at parties.
I started planning the throne because I was tired of being a joke with an altar.
And now I have it, and there is nobody left who remembers I was ever the joke. Except me.
route666: The camper you sleep in. I know every bolt of it.
We ran Route 666 for years. Three Americas, end to end, and a bank in every second town.
He drove. I did the safes. You do not need a drill if you can lean on the odds until the tumblers agree with you.
Do you know how easy it is to be good at something when the universe is embarrassed to say no to you?
That was the best I have ever been. Not the throne. A bad camper and a man who sang badly to the radio.
paradox: December 1992. You will have read the official version.
I killed Maat. Goddess of justice, weighed hearts against a feather, the whole business. I threw a tower through her.
Except I have not done it yet. I do it in 2012. The tower arrived twenty years early and ninety-two dimensions off course, and it has been unravelling everything ever since.
So I have to keep walking towards it. Every step towards the throne is a step towards the woman who throws the spear.
That is the only way I ever get near enough to decide not to.
bubba: He is why it ended. Not a fight. Not another woman. A paradox with my face on it.
I left in December because staying meant letting the timeline come apart around him, and he would have let me.
I still love him. I want to be extremely clear about that, since you sleep three metres from him.
I cannot have him. Not because of you. Because of me, in twenty years, with a spear.
The only thing in ninety-two dimensions I am not allowed to touch, and I built the courthouse that decides what anyone is allowed to touch.
jealousy: I owe you something. Not an apology. Something adjacent to one.
Every door that stuck. Every coin that fell wrong. Every train you missed by four seconds. That was me.
I know he feels nothing for you. I checked. I keep checking, which is the humiliating part.
It was never really about what you are to him. It is that you get to be near him and I do not.
I have been using the machinery of cosmic law to trip a witch in the street. Say it out loud and it sounds exactly as small as it is.
throne: New Year's Eve, 2000. The Father died in the Solomon ritual and the throne went empty.
I sat down in it. Not because I had won anything. Because the room went quiet and nobody said no.
Every god in existence looked at me and decided it was easier to let it happen.
I inherited the justice of ninety-two dimensions that night. Billions of trials a day. No training, no precedent, no Maat, because I am the reason there is no Maat.
I have no idea what I am doing, Em. I have never had any idea what I am doing.
futureSelf: Here is the one I have never said to anyone.
I am afraid of her. Of me. Of the one in 2012 with the tower in her hand.
She was me once, sitting exactly here, thinking she would be the one to decide differently.
Every year I become slightly more like her and slightly less able to notice it happening.
If I ever stop being able to tell the difference, Em... you have a spear. You know where the tower is.

Okay. Okay okay okay. Hi. {I'm fine.|This is fine.|Everything's arranged, mostly.}

Hello, brief thing. {That's affectionate.|It's the nicest thing I call anyone.|You'll understand eventually, or better, you won't.}
